title: A facile in situ integration of red mud-derived metal oxides into graphene sheets for sulfamethoxazole removal from water
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29367-29376
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04400F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nguyen Thi Mai, Le Thi Thanh Hoa, Dang Van Thanh, Nguyen Nhat Huy, Hoang Minh Trang, Tran Van Son, Pham Thi Thuy, Nguyen Thi An Hang, Tran Thi Minh Hang, Nguyen Manh Khai
In this study, we present a facile in situ integration of red mud-derived metal oxides into graphene sheets via an electrochemical method, and we demonstrate its application for sonodegradation of sulfamethoxazole (SMX) in water.
